content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Event Configuration ## slug: event-configuration ## seoTitle: Event Configuration ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Our {{variable.Object_Event}} creation process is designed to be lightweight but robust if needed— you can get an {{variable.Object_Event}} live in just three steps. 1. {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} 2. {{variable.Object_Event}} Details 3. {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s :::(Info) (Notice) If this is your first time creating an Event, please follow the instructions below to become familiar with the objects and fields. Additional features, like creating checkout questions or relabeling tabs are listed at the bottom of this page. ::: ## Pre-requisites If an {{variable.Object_Event}} includes a free {{variable.Object_EventItem}} (Main event ticket) and a Donation {{variable.Object_EventItem}}, a {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} is required in order to publish the {{variable.Object_Event}}. ### Sandbox If you create an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} with {{variable.Field_EventItem_Address}} set to “Optional” or “Required” in a Sandbox, you must set the {{variable.Field_EventItem_Country}} field to “Required.” You will get an error if the {{variable.Field_EventItem_Country}} field is set to “Hide” (default setting). ## Create an Event Settings Record The {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} are the back end to your {{variable.Object_Event}}. They control things like the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}, {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Font}}, colors, {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Venue}}, and language options. 1. Click the App Launcher. 2. Enter and click {{variable.Product_EventsPlannerApp}}. 3. Click the Event Settings tab. 4. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 5. Complete the following fields. You can add additional information after the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record is created. * {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_SettingName}} (required) * Check {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_Default}} if this record will be the default {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. * Select the payment method types that you will accept. * {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_BkgrndColor}} * {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CardClrThem}} 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![EventConfig_Feb24_EventSetting](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventConfig_Feb24_EventSetting.png){height="" width=""} For additional features, click [here](/v1/docs/event-features). ## Create Your First Event The {{variable.Object_Event}} object stores information about your {{variable.Object_Event}}, including what, where, and when. It’s also the place where you can find links to everything else that pertains to the {{variable.Object_Event}}. 1. Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}. ![EventConfig_Feb24_Create%20Event](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventConfig_Feb24_Create%20Event.png){height="" width=""} 3. Fill in the fields in the sections below. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ### Information * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}} (required) * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_TimeZone}} (required) * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventGroup}} - Leave the field blank if the {{variable.Object_Event}} will not be associated with an [{{variable.Object_EventGroup}}](/v1/docs/event-groups){target=`_blank`}. * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} - Click [here](/v1/docs/ui-experience-2){target=`_blank`} for more information about the different user interfaces. * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_FormPostRegistra}} - Click [here](/v1/docs/custom-questions){target=`_blank`} for more information about {{variable.Object_Form}}s. * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PostEventQuestio}} ![Create%20Event_New_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Event_New_1.png){height="" width=""} #### About the Status and Publish Fields **{{variable.Field_ETEvent_Publish}}** If an {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Publish}} (conference360__Visible__c) field is set to “True” or checked, then the {{variable.Object_Event}} will be viewable via the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventURL}} and on all public {{variable.Object_EventGroup}}s and {{variable.Object_Event}} lists. If the field is unchecked, the {{variable.Object_Event}} can only be viewed by clicking the **Preview** button. **{{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}}** The {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} field shows the internal status of the {{variable.Object_Event}} and is used by Admins. For example, an Admin might change the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} to “Draft” to let other Admins know that they are updating the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. The values “Draft,” “Active,” “Canceled”, and “Completed” do not reflect if the {{variable.Object_Event}} has been published. The {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} is set to “Active” by default when the {{variable.Object_Event}} is created. Once the {{variable.Object_Event}} record exists, an Admin must manually change the field to "Completed" or "Canceled" or use the [Blackthorn | Events Status Update scheduled job](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/events-admin-tab-scheduled-jobs#blackthorn-events-status-update){target=`_blank`} to update the field’s value. ### Free or Paid? • {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Free}} – check if the {{variable.Object_Event}} will be free. • {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}} – Select a [{{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}](/v1/docs/payment-gateway-setup){target=`_blank`} if the {{variable.Object_Event}} is paid. • {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Currency}} • {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartDate}} • {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartTime}} • {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesEndDate}} • {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesEndTime}} ![Create%20Event_New_2_Free%20or%20Paid](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Event_New_2_Free%20or%20Paid.png){height="" width=""} #### About the Sales Start/End Fields Use the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartDate}}, {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartTime}}, {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesEndDate}}, and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesEndTime}} fields to control when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can register for an {{variable.Object_Event}}. These fields are different than the date when the {{variable.Object_Event}} occurs. (You must add them to the Event record page layout since they are not automatically added to it.) If the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartDate}} is set to a date before the day the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} tries to register or is left blank, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will be able to register for the {{variable.Object_Event}}. ![Event_Sales%20End%20Date_blank](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event_Sales%20End%20Date_blank.png){height="" width=""} If the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartDate}} is set to a date if the future, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will not be able to register for the {{variable.Object_Event}} until the date listed. ![Event_Sales%20End%20Date_Filled](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event_Sales%20End%20Date_Filled.png){height="" width=""} If the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartDate}} is in the past, the registration window has closed. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will no longer be able to register, and a Closed banner will appear. ![Event_Sales%20End%20Date_Before%20Today](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event_Sales%20End%20Date_Before%20Today.png){height="" width=""} IMPORTANT: If an {{variable.Object_EventItem}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_SalesStaDate}} is before the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartDate}}, the registration page will show the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartDate}}. ### Dates * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartDate}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartTime}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndTime}} ![Create%20Event_New_2_Dates](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Event_New_2_Dates.png){height="" width=""} **NOTE:** The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ETStartDateTime}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ETEndDateTime}} fields should be used for formula fields, email templates, etc. They will pull the correct date and time regardless of time zone for the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}. ### URLs & Info * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PostRegistration}} – Define what will happen after the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} submits their registration. If you select "Show Success Message", enter your message in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_RegSuccessMsg}} field. If you select "Redirect to URL", enter the URL in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_RedirectURL}} field. * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMtgURL}} – Click [here](/v1/docs/webinar-integration){target=`_blank`} for more information about webinar integrations. * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebiMeetPassword}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinMeetingAcct}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WebinarMeetingID}} * {{variable.Field_Event_ZoomURLCalendDescr}} - When checked, {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s will see Zoom links in the invite’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CalendarDescript}} with text similar to “To join the meeting directly, click here: [link].” ![Create%20Event_New_2_URLS%20and%20Info](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Event_New_2_URLS%20and%20Info.png){height="" width=""} #### More About Images The image in the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} field will appear on the cover of the {{variable.Object_Event}}. ![Event Cover Image](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event%20Cover%20Image.png){height="" width=""} * The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} link needs to be HTTPS, not HTTP. * For a Salesforce File, copy the public link. * Classic Salesforce Document, mark "Externally Available", right click on the image, copy the image address. * Classic In the editor, both Upload Image/Web Address image upload options work. See below. ![Insert Image](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Insert%20Image.png){height="" width=""} Check [here](/v1/docs/event-images) to see more details about images. ### Description & Messages * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Description}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_RegSuccessMsg}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_AttenLinkInviMes}} ![Create%20Event_New_3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Event_New_3.png){height="" width=""} ### Display or Hide Features * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CodeSettings}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContactUsEmail}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_FormPreRegistrat}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvents_WiFiMessage}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WiFiNetwork}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WiFiPassword}} ![Create%20Event_New_4_Display%20or%20Hide](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Event_New_4_Display%20or%20Hide.png){height="" width=""} ### Venue * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Venue}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueName}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueStreet}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueCity}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueStateProvin}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueCountry}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenuePostalCode}} ![Create%20Event_New_4_Venue](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Event_New_4_Venue.png){height="" width=""} ### Capacity * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_TotalCapacity}} ![Create%20Event_New_4_Capacity](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Event_New_4_Capacity.png){height="" width=""} ### Waitlisting * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistEnabled}} - Click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/event-waitlisting){target=`_blank`} for more information about waitlisting. * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_WaitlistCapacity}} ![Create%20Event_New_4_Waitlisting](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Event_New_4_Waitlisting.png){height="" width=""} ### Budget & Expense Summaries If you want to enter a budget for each category, you can do so here or on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record page. If you want to relate the {{variable.Object_Event}} to {{variable.Object_BudgetExpense}} records, these fields will automatically update. Click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/event-budget-and-expense){target=`_blank`} for information about the {{variable.Object_BudgetExpense}} object. * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_AudioVisuaBudget}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_AudioVisuExpense}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CateringBudget}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_CateringExpenses}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContingencBudget}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContingenExpense}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_DecorBudget}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_DecorExpenses}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EntertainBudget}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EntertainExpense}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_MarketingBudget}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_MarketingExpense}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_MktgSocialBudget}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_MktgSocialExpens}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_OtherBudget}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_OtherExpenses}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PlanOrganiBudget}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ProdStaffExpense}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SiteRentalBudget}} * {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SiteRentalExpens}} ![Create%20Event_New_6](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Create%20Event_New_6.png){height="" width=""} Click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/events-objects-create-event){target=`_blank`} to learn more about all the {{variable.Object_Event}} record’s fields. ### Your New Event Record ![ConfigEvent_New%20Event%20Record](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/ConfigEvent_New%20Event%20Record.png){height="" width=""} ## Create Event Items There are [three primary types of {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/event-items-overview){target=`_blank`} that can be added to an {{variable.Object_Event}}: Tickets, Donations, and Products. For this example, we will focus on Tickets. To learn more about the other types, click [Donations](https://docs.blackthorn.io/v1/docs/event-donations){target=`_blank`} or [Products](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/event-products){target=`_blank`}. ### About Event Item Tickets {{snippet.EventItem_MainEventTicketAbout}} ### Create a Ticket 1. From the {{variable.Object_Event}} record, click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s {{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}. 2. Fill in the fields in the sections below. 3. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![Create a New Event Item from Event Record](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventConfig_CreateNewEventItemfromEventRecord.png){height="" width=""} #### Information & Description {{snippet.EventItem_InfoAndDescription}} #### Availability & Limits The {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_SalesStaDate}} and {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_SalesEndDate}} specify which days the tickets are available for purchase. For example, If the Event is on 12/31 for New Year's Eve, you may want to stop ticket sales by 12/20 to ensure you can organize food and drinks for the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s. * {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_SalesStaDate}} * {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_SalesEndDate}} * {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_SalesStaTime}} * {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_SalesEndTime}} IMPORTANT: If an Event Item’s {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_SalesStaDate}} is before the Event’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartDate}}, the registration page will show the Event’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_SalesStartDate}}. #### Capacity & Waitlisting {{snippet.EventItem_CapacityWaitlisting}} #### Attendee Form There are multiple fields on the Attendee Form that you can hide, make required, or show as optional for each Main event ticket. For example, if you have a "Child Under 3 Yrs" ticket for sale, it is unlikely that the child has an email address. Therefore, you can hide the {{variable.Field_EventItem_Email}} field from this Event Item's Attendee Form. ![Event Item_Attendee Form Settings ](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event%20Item_Attendee%20Form%20Settings%20.png){height="" width=""} {{snippet.EV_EventItem_Create_AttendForm}} **Attendee Form Example** ![EventItem_Ticket_AttendeeForm](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventItem_Ticket_AttendeeForm.png){height="" width=""} #### Settings * An {{variable.Object_EventItem}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantiRemain}} will show on the registration page only when there are 10 or fewer {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s available. * Select a previously created {{variable.Object_Form}} or create a new one. Click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/custom-questions){target=`_blank`} for more information about creating {{variable.Object_Form}}s and {{variable.Object_FormElement}}s. * Check {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Hidden}} if you want to hide the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} from the {{variable.Object_Event}} checkout process. * To set a minimum or a maximum number of {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s allowed per order, enter the amounts in the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_MaxQuantity}} and/or {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_MinQuantity}} fields. ## Publish Your First Event ### Authorize Events If you do not see the {{variable.Button_Events_Publish}} and {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} buttons, but instead see the {{variable.Button_Events_Authorize}} button, your {{variable.Product_Events}} app has not been authorized in your org. ![events authorize_button](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/events%20authorize_button.png){height="" width=""} To complete authentication, click the {{variable.Button_Events_Authorize}} button and follow the steps. You will be returned to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record page, and the {{variable.Button_Events_Publish}} and {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} buttons will now be visible. ### Publish an Event Click {{variable.Button_Events_Publish}} to publish the {{variable.Object_Event}}. Once the {{variable.Object_Event}} is published, your {{variable.Object_Event}} can be viewed by anyone. ![Click the Publish button.](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventConfig_Click%20Publish.png){height="" width=""} ### Update an Event Most changes made to your Event will automatically update your Event. To ensure that all udpates are made to a published Event, click the Update button. Most changes made to your {{variable.Object_Event}} will automatically update your Event. To ensure that all updates are made to a published {{variable.Object_Event}}, click the {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} button. ![Click the Update button.](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventConfig_Click%20Update.png){height="" width=""} ### View Your Event Click the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventURL}} and view your live Event. ![EventConfig_Published%20Event](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventConfig_Published%20Event.png){height="" width=""} If the {{variable.Object_Event}} or {{variable.Object_EventItem}}(s) are not rendering after publishing, please watch this quick video about how to troubleshoot visibility controls. ![Hosted Event Launch from Event URL](https://youtu.be/BKKZ45yuDEA){height="480" width="640"} ## Next Steps 1. Create [{{variable.Object_Session}}](/v1/docs/create-event-sessions), [{{variable.Object_EventFAQ}}s](/v1/docs/add-event-faqs-to-an-event-listing), [{{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Object_Speaker}}s](/v1/docs/event-speakers), [{{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Object_Sponsor}}s](/v1/docs/event-sponsors), and [{{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Object_Staff}}](/v1/docs/event-staff) records related to your {{variable.Object_Event}}. 2. Learn how the [{{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Task_Checkout}} process](/v1/docs/event-checkout-process) works.
